narrative.intro: Bechtel Plant Machinery has $2.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, from 8 awards and an average award size of $259M. Historical obligations show multi-year activity with FY21 at $2B, FY22 at $2.1B, FY23 at $1.4B, FY24 at $2.2B, and FY25 at $2.1B, matching the FY26 reported level of $2.1B. The dataset distinguishes between contract obligations and award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables; the reported obligations here are obligations except where award-value is explicitly noted. This snapshot shows a firm with a small number of large awards and a recent modest decline in obligations compared with the prior year.
